title: Pattern Module Contract
description: Design contract for the pattern-extraction step (modules/analysis today owns this responsibility per 11_Benchmark_Engine/README.md; this contract is kept separate because Reports and a future Dashboard sync both consume it independently of raw AnalysisOutput). Pattern takes one company's scored findings plus the existing pattern_tracker state and decides which UX patterns are new, which are escalating, and how each should be classified — codifying the 'Pattern Library Rules' and 'Strategic Classification System' from CLAUDE.md. Not implemented yet.

IndustryPosition.description: Axis 1 of CLAUDE.md's Strategic Classification System.

ProductTypeFit.description: Axis 2a — Saudia Feasibility / Product Type Fit.

PatternInput.description: What Pattern needs to classify one company's findings against the shared pattern library.

analysis_output.description: Pattern reads ux_patterns and innovation_scores off Analysis's output — it does not re-derive them.

existing_pattern_tracker.description: Optional. A snapshot of Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's pattern_tracker at the time of this run, so Pattern can compute deltas (new vs. updated) instead of guessing. Absent on the very first benchmark ever run.

companies.description: Company slugs the pattern has been seen in so far.

PatternOutput.description: The classified pattern findings for this run, ready to (a) feed Reports' emerging_patterns deliverable and (b) be applied as a patch to Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's pattern_tracker — application is manual, per CLAUDE.md's hard rules; Pattern only proposes.

findings.description: One entry per UX pattern this company scored 4+ on Innovation for, per CLAUDE.md's pattern-extraction rule ('identify every interaction scoring 4+ on Innovation').

id.description: Snake_case id matching (or proposing) a key in Master_Benchmark_Matrix.json's pattern_tracker, e.g. 'geo_aware_cold_start'.

companies_seen_in.description: Full updated list including this run's company — not just this run's contribution.

count.description: Equal to companies_seen_in.length; kept explicit to match the existing pattern_tracker shape.

expected_12_24m.description: Optional. Per CLAUDE.md: 'Always note which classification you expect in 12-24 months, not just today.'

saudia_feasibility.description: Optional — required before a finding can flow into a Saudia opportunity brief, but Pattern may leave it for Reports to fill in.

escalations.description: Optional. Subset of findings whose industry_position changed this run (e.g. Emerging Trend -> Table Stakes at the 5th sighting) — surfaced separately so Reports can call them out explicitly, matching the Dashboard's 'escalate classification' language.
